title: LLM empowered smart hydrology
summary: ZTE reports approximately 30% less hydrology report-writing time and 20% better line-drawing efficiency in its operational hydrology application.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: ZTE describes an operational hydrology model with the Changjiang Hydrological Bureau as a partner. It reports shorter report writing, faster thalweg drawing, and prediction and query accuracy figures. The system is intended to support water management and flood planning. The source does not describe a particular flood intervention or prevented loss.
purpose: Improve hydrological analysis, reporting, and planning.

ratings.reason: The operational ZTE/Changjiang Hydrological Bureau case reports approximately 30% less report-writing time.
No flood-response decision or prevented loss is documented.

ai_role.statement: The contributor describes the system and its proposed or reported contribution. This collection entry does not independently isolate the effect of AI from the surrounding workflow.

evidence.citation: Contributed use case in International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact, 2025. Information current as of June 2025. The reported outcomes are attributed to the submitting project, not an independent outcome evaluation by ITU.
evidence.title: Use Case 7: LLM empowered smart hydrology

produced_by: The contributor describes the application and its setting in the cited entry. Conditions sufficient to reproduce the reported benefit have not been established.
must_hold: Requirements for reproducing the benefit need to be evaluated in the new setting. The collection entry does not establish that its reported results will recur.

headline: A hydrology model reports faster operational reporting
